A porta cabin is a factory-built steel cabin used as a site office, security post, storage room, or worker unit. SAMAN POS India Pvt Ltd manufactures steel porta cabins at its Bangalore factory and delivers them across Hyderabad and Telangana by road. For the city's industrial belts at Jeedimetla, Patancheru, and Cherlapally, a ready cabin arrives prepared to place and use, cutting out the long site-build time of conventional construction.

Why Hyderabad Buyers Choose SAMAN

SAMAN is a direct manufacturer, not a reseller. We started in 2009 and incorporated as SAMAN POS India Pvt Ltd in 2019, building every cabin in-house under ISO 9001:2015, ISO 14001:2015, and ISO 45001:2018 management systems, with NSIC government-purchase enlistment and DPIIT startup recognition. Buying factory-direct means you work with the people who build, customise, and stand behind the cabin — not a middleman adding margin.

We dispatch from our Bangalore plant to Hyderabad by road. Standard delivery is ₹3,000 with 3–5 day transit nationally; for a ready unit the road movement to Hyderabad is short, and we coordinate crane or hydraulic unloading at your site. The same cabin can later be unbolted and relocated to your next project — capital you keep, not a sunk cost.

Porta Cabin Demand Across Hyderabad

Hyderabad's industrial map drives steady porta cabin demand, and the right cabin depends on where your site is.

The pharma and manufacturing clusters at Patancheru (502319), IDA Bollaram (502325), and Genome Valley use project site offices, security posts, and storage cabins during plant and facility construction. These belts run along the Hyderabad–Solapur highway side and the city's north-west industrial corridor.

The established industrial estates at Jeedimetla (500055) and Balanagar (500042) — machine tools, electricals, and small-to-medium manufacturing — need compact office cabins, guard cabins, and storage units that fit estate plots.

The eastern manufacturing belt at Cherlapally (500051) and Mallapur (500076), on the Uppal–Kapra side, drives demand for site offices, worker units, and security cabins for factories and warehouses.

On the city fringes, the warehousing and logistics parks along the Outer Ring Road and the Shamshabad airport corridor add steady demand for site offices, security cabins, and storage units as new sheds and facilities are built out.

Across all these zones, construction and infrastructure work needs temporary site offices and labour units that go up fast and move on to the next project. If your site sits in any of these areas, we can advise the cabin size and fit-out that suits the work.

Porta Cabin Types for Hyderabad Buyers

Most Hyderabad requirements fall into four cabin types, and the right choice starts with how the unit will be used on site.

An office or site office cabin is the most common — a single room or a partitioned layout for site engineers, project managers, and admin staff, with windows, electrical points, and optional AC and toilet. On an active construction site it serves as the project's working base until handover.

A security or guard cabin is a compact unit, often a single-person footprint, placed at a gate or boundary to control entry and watch movement; larger versions add a small toilet for longer shifts. A storage cabin is a closed, lockable steel unit that keeps tools, materials, and documents dry and secure on site, while a worker or labour unit gives site crews a clean, ventilated rest or accommodation space sized to the headcount.

Porta Cabin Sizes and Build

Every SAMAN MS porta cabin is built on a steel frame to IS 2062, with the panel and fit-out matched to the use:

Element Specification
FrameMS steel structure to IS 2062
Wall & roof panelsSandwich / PUF insulated panels or cement board
FlooringPlywood with vinyl, or chequered sheet for heavy use
Doors & windowsSteel/aluminium door, sliding windows with grills
ElectricalLight, fan, and socket points wired to a DB
OptionsAC provision, toilet/washroom, partition, extra windows

Common sizes run from compact 10×10 ft guard cabins up to 20 ft and 40 ft office units, and we build to your required dimensions. Exact panel grades and fittings are confirmed at quotation against your drawing.

Customisation for Your Site

You choose the layout and fit-out: single open office or partitioned rooms, toilet or pantry, AC, extra electrical points, window placement, and exterior colour. A security cabin can be built compact for a single guard at a gate; a site office can be sized for a project team with a meeting space. Tell us the use and we configure the cabin around it.

What Sets the Price

A porta cabin's price depends on real factors, not a flat rate: the size, the wall panel type (PUF vs cement board), the flooring grade, insulation, the number of electrical points, AC or toilet provision, and the transport distance to your Hyderabad zone. A compact guard cabin and a fitted 40 ft office sit at very different price points. We quote against your actual size and fit-out rather than a vague figure — share your requirement and you get a clear number. Sharing your site zone, the cabin size or footprint, the panel and flooring grade, and whether you need AC, a toilet, or partitions lets us quote accurately the first time, without back-and-forth.

Delivery and Installation to Hyderabad

Your cabin is fabricated at our Bangalore factory and dispatched by road to Hyderabad. Ready units move quickly once loaded; we allow time for loading, traffic, check-posts, site access, and crane coordination. On arrival we offload by crane or hydraulic system and place the unit on your prepared base. Confirm your site has firm, level ground and clear vehicle access before delivery day.

The road haul runs from our Bangalore plant to Hyderabad along the NH-44 corridor; most ready units reach the city in about two working days, inside the standard 3–5 day transit window, while custom builds dispatch once the fit-out is signed off. We plan the offload around your site — a hydraulic truck or a crane depending on the unit size and how close the vehicle can reach the final position.

FAQs: Porta Cabin in Hyderabad

How long does delivery to Hyderabad take?

A ready cabin moves from our Bangalore factory to Hyderabad by road within the standard 3–5 day transit window; custom-built units depend on the fit-out, and we confirm a date at order.

What does a porta cabin cost in Hyderabad?

It depends on size, panel type, flooring, insulation, electrical points, and any AC or toilet provision. A compact guard cabin and a fitted office cabin are priced very differently. Share your size and use and we quote against it.

What sizes are available?

From compact 10×10 ft guard cabins to 20 ft and 40 ft office units, plus custom dimensions built to your drawing.

Can I rent a porta cabin in Hyderabad instead of buying?

We are a manufacturer focused on built-to-order supply. Tell us your requirement and timeline and we will advise the best option for your project.

Do I need to prepare the site before delivery?

Yes — firm, level ground and clear access for the delivery vehicle and crane. We guide you on base preparation when you order.

How long does a porta cabin last?

On an MS frame to IS 2062 with insulated panels, the cabin carries 5 years structural frame and base cover, 1–2 years on finishing, and a 20–25 year engineered service life.

Get Your Porta Cabin in Hyderabad

Tell us your site zone, size, and use, and we will recommend the cabin and quote against your requirement. Call +91 88616 22859 or +91 80886 85440 for Bangalore and South India, and +91 87960 39938 or +91 97089 89937 for Delhi NCR and North India, or send an enquiry.

SAMAN supplies porta cabins across South India — see our porta cabin in Chennai page or our guide to porta cabins in Bangalore for nearby dispatch and delivery details.
